quest.title: The Chasm's Bounty
quest.description: A Liyue miner named Qi Ding has somehow gone missing. Seeing as how The Chasm is a perilous place, you decide to help look for him.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: What happened? He was absent this morning during the headcount. Where on earth is he?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: If the higher-ups find out... I'd be toast.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. Good timing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened? Why are you sighing?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: *sigh* To tell you the truth, a miner from our camp went missing.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: The Chasm has a complex environment. Though things have stabilized a bit lately, it's still dangerous deep inside. So, we made it a rule to take a headcount every morning and evening.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Qi Ding — the guy who never misses a chance to brag about his daughter — was absent last night.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: During the headcount, other miners said that they had just met him and that he might return very soon. So I let it go.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: But this morning, he was still nowhere to be found. Other miners looked evasive, so I pressed them for an honest answer. It turned out that Qi Ding hadn't returned the whole night...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Now we're in big trouble. Don't tell me it's happening again...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: *sigh* This is something that only Ministry personnel should know.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: But since you're the hero who saved Liyue, I think I can make an exception for you.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: This was before The Chasm was sealed... At first, it was just a strange rumor among miners that something in The Chasm could "make their wish come true."

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: We had warned them to report to Huishan Hall should they encounter anything unusual.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Yet some miners tried their luck — They went looking for "The Chasm's Bounty" in secret and ended up going missing one by one.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: When we found them some while later, they'd all gone pretty insane. It took quite some time for them to recover. That was creepy. After the incident, the Qixing decided to seal The Chasm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could the missing miner be...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Yes, I suspect Qi Ding got himself into the same situation.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Should anything happen to him, I'll definitely lose my job. *sigh* What's more, his wife passed away many years ago, and his daughter is now an intern at the Ministry of Civil Affairs. If we can't find him...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: #*sigh* {NICKNAME}, I'm gonna have people put up some missing person posters, but can you help me look for him...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Mm, let me think if there's anything noticeable about him. He used to be on the demolitions team, there's always a strong gunpowder smell on him... Hope you find this useful.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: #*sigh* Qi Ding, I warned you not to go down. You aren't like {NICKNAME}...

talks.objective: Search for Qi Ding, the missing miner

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: Wh—Where is it? Where is it!

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: If I can't find it... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's with this strong gunpowder smell? Who are you, and what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: My name is Qi Ding. I—I lost something here. I must find it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qi Ding? Isn't he the missing miner that Muning talked about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's bring him back to the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: No! I'm not coming back!

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: I'm not returning unless I find it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, what are you looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: I—I'm looking for a toy, a doll of the size of my palm...

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: I lost it when I came down into the mine.

choices.text: Do you always bring a toy with you?

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: I know it sounds weird, but I had it in case I lost it.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: You don't know how much trouble I went through to get this doll. It's expensive — I'd even call it daylight robbery — and every time the Feiyun Commerce Guild had it in stock, I was in the mine, so I always missed my chance to purchase it.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: But last time, when my daughter saw another kid holding this doll in their arms, she had her eyes fixed on it. My daughter is such a considerate and sweet child — she knows that we aren't well-off, so she never tells me what she wants.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: But a father always knows.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: So I asked my friend to buy one from the Feiyun Commerce Guild and send it to the mine. I carried it with me all the time in case I lost it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yet that didn't really help.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: *sigh*... Miners like us live off a poor salary. After spending most of it on supporting the family, I ain't got much left. Then, there was this doll that cost a fortune.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Well, I can always earn more money. B—But I've already written to my daughter to tell her that I've bought her the doll she wanted...

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: How am I supposed to face her when I return home this month?

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: She never makes any complaints. I know that she wouldn't do so even if I return home empty-handed, but, *sob*, it'll simply break my heart to see the disappointment in her eyes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's awful...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we help him find the doll?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's give it a try.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But The Chasm's still a pretty dangerous place, so let's return to the camp together first. Then, we'll come back and look for your doll.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Really? Thank you so much!

choices.text: You brought a toy into the mine?

talks.objective: Talk to Qi Ding, the miner at The Chasm

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: Wh—Where is it? Where is it!

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: If I can't find it... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's with the strong smell of gunpowder... What are you looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding

talks.objective: Hand the confused Qi Ding over to Jinwu

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Qi Ding, is that you? Where have you been? Muning has even sent men to the camp to look for you...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're also here. What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: M—My toy is missing...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Your toy? What toy? Aren't you a bit too old for this?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: No, it's not mine. It's for my daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: You know, the doll from the Feiyun Commerce Guild — it's about the size of my palm.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Oh, the toy you bought for your daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: Yeah! That's the one!

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: But I—I lost it...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Is it really necessary to get so upset?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: Hey! That toy is for my daughter, and I just bought it! My poor little girl, she didn't even get to take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to tell her now that I lost her doll...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: #Where did you find him, {NICKNAME}? Was it in The Chasm?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: *sigh* The Chasm is like a complex labyrinth. The deeper you go, the creepier it becomes.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Qi Ding has always been a steady and dependable person. Seems being trapped down there has made him both emotionally and mentally vulnerable.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: I'll send him up later. He will be fine with some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: No, I'm not going back. I won't go unless I find the doll.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: The doll...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No worries. {NICKNAME} and Paimon will look for it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finding the doll should help calm him down a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: R—Really? Will you help me look for my doll?

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: There's only so many places I went to when I descended into the mines.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: *sob* Please, you must find the doll.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: *sigh* So be it.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I'm gonna bring him up. Muning was like a cat on hot bricks when he didn't show up during the headcount.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Now with him back, Muning can finally be at ease.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: By the way, please exercise caution when you go down. To be honest, um, it's no biggie if you don't find the doll.

talks.objective: Help Qi Ding look for the lost doll

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, wh—who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is there a little girl in The Chasm?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: Me? My name is Qi Nan. I—I'm Qi Ding's daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qi Ding's daughter?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: Yeah, my father is, uh, a miner working in The Chasm. He's a great person — my mother died shortly after giving birth to me, so my father brought me up on his own.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: It's so dark down in The Chasm... (But for my sake, father endured the fear and stayed here, exerting himself.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, why are you here?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: I—I miss my father. He's very busy in the mines and usually comes home only once every month.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: When he's away, I'm left alone at home... (I'd be so lonely and scared should anything happen.)

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: But you see, everything will be fine if I can go down into the mine. (When I'm in the camp, I'll be with father every day. He can take care of me and protect me.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yep... {NICKNAME} has a point. This place is super dangerous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let us bring you back to the camp...

response.speaker: Qi Nan
response.text: No way! I snuck in here. If my father finds out, he'll get so mad that he won't ever allow me to come out and play again.

response.speaker: Qi Nan
response.text: Oh, right! Aren't you looking for the doll?

response.speaker: Qi Nan
response.text: I know where it is... Hee-hee, follow me.

talks.objective: Defeat the Abyss creatures near to the box

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: I have no idea what I'm gonna do if someone bullies me when father's away.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: How I wish father could stay at home longer...

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: If he's always there with me, I can stop pretending to be the "considerate child." Instead, I may allow myself to seek some attention, and be a naive — and even a bit spoiled — daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: Uh... The toy? It's right in front of you.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: Father must be very anxious after losing the toy. We must find it soon.

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Object
dialogues.text: (There is a dampened chest that smells of gunpowder.)

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Object
dialogues.text: (You find messy footprints around it.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon thought Qi Ding would've left the doll in this chest. The gunpowder smell here is identical to that of Qi Ding's.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But there's only some damp gunpowder inside it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, a sheet of paper? What does it say?

dialogues.speaker: A Sheet of Paper
dialogues.text: "...I ran into that rock again. I bet it has to do with the sealing of the mine..."

dialogues.speaker: A Sheet of Paper
dialogues.text: "...Now that she's landed a job at the Ministry of Civil Affairs, she needs money on many fronts. I can't afford to have my work interrupted as it was two years ago when they closed the mine."

dialogues.speaker: A Sheet of Paper
dialogues.text: "...Qi Ding, for your daughter's sake, you have to blow that rock up!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like someone tore it out of a notebook.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could the person be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It must be Qi Ding.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why did Qi Ding bring the gunpowder here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Was he going to blow something up? Well, that's not the topic for now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Where on earth is it?

talks.objective: Look for the source of the voice
Look for the doll in the place Qi Nan indicated

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: Ah, why did you chase them away...

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: They were playing with me. Hee-hee, they tried to catch me but failed each time. It was super fun.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not fun if they catch you!

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: No worries... They won't. Oh, right, aren't you looking for the doll?

dialogues.speaker: Qi Nan
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's right there.

talks.objective: Defeat the Abyss creatures near Qi Nan

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: You two found Qi Ding, right? Jinwu told me already.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: So he said he wasn't going to work in the mine anymore? OK, he needs to go home and rest.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Are you saying that a "Wish Granter" caused all this? That's nonsense! I bet it has to do with the depressing atmosphere in the mine. Anyone could develop some mental issues down there.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I dare not imagine what would happen to Qi Ding hadn't you been there. It took very long for those hallucinated miners to recover.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: They don't even know what happened to them.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: You've been running around in The Chasm lately. Do be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: You didn't see the state Qi Ding was in when he was sent up. He was shouting in tears about his daughter...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, speaking of his daughter, we met Qi Nan.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Qi Nan? Oh, that's Qi Ding's daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Did anything happen to her?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: His daughter — the little girl — looked for the doll with us down there. It's good to know that she came out of The Chasm safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Qi Ding's daughter, Qi Nan? A little girl? What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Qi Ding's daughter made it into the Ministry of Civil Affairs this year. She's all grown up now. Besides, the Ministry is looking for experts to investigate the incident in The Chasm. She is too busy to come here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But we saw...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I don't care what you saw...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Just pretend you didn't see anything.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Alright, Qi Ding is back safe and sound. You should also, um, get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The doll looks somewhat ragged... Anyway, let's bring it to Qi Ding.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, don't forget to bring Qi Nan along. He must be very happy to see his daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qi Nan, huh, where is she? She just vanished suddenly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm... This is pretty weird. But let's bring the doll to Qi Ding and ask him about it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, Paimon hopes that nothing happens to Qi Nan in the meantime...

choices.text: Something doesn't seem to add up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, when did Qi Nan disappear? Paimon didn't even hear any sound...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This does feel pretty weird. Why don't we bring the doll to Qi Ding and tell him about his daughter?

talks.objective: Bring the doll back to camp and pass it to Qi Ding

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qi Ding!

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: #Huh? If it isn't the famous {NICKNAME} and... your flying companion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Flying companion"! How rude!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's, uh, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: #I'm sorry. Paimon, {NICKNAME}, are you... looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, have you forgotten? You asked us to help you find the toy, but we only found a chest full of dampened gunpowder.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: *sigh*... My apologies. Something must've affected me while I was stuck in The Chasm. Felt like I was in daze, to be honest, one that I've only just recovered from a bit after being sent back up.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: Jinwu said I made a scene down there, crying and shouting... H—How embarrassing.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: But now that you mentioned the gunpowder, I remember it. I did plan to... blow up the "Wish Granter."

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Before the mine was sealed, a few miners who went down into the mine came back saying that they found a Wish Granter that grants whatever wish you might have.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To think such a miracle exists... Paimon's just curious, by the way — is the Wish Granter still there?

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: I believe so. It's a very huge rock floating among other giant boulders. Also, it emits a faint light...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm, this sounds somewhat familiar...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's the huge crystal that Zhiqiong and we came across.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Ah? Did you run into the Wish Granter as well? You'd better be careful when you get close.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Some miners went insane because of it, which led to the Qixing sealing the mine. I couldn't find a stable job for years because of it.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: I ran into that rock again this time. If this part of the mine got sealed because of it once more, I would lose my job again and end up taking on poorly paid gigs at the harbor.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: So I decided to blow that rock up.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: But... after I went down, the closer I got, the more intense my headache grew. I couldn't even think straight...

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: I even saw — no, I think it was just a hallucination. Anyway, I heard them saying that I'd have been in dire peril if you hadn't shown up.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Thank you so much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No need to thank us. We're just doing as we should!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, don't forget this. We found the doll...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It looks ragged. Paimon doesn't know if it's the one that you lost.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Wh—Why do you have it!? Where did you find it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is the doll that you asked us to look for.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Did I ask you to look for this doll? How weird! I bought it at the Feiyun Commerce Guild some time back. It cost me a fortune.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Well, it made a good gift for my daughter anyway. But as she grew older, she no longer needed it. I thought it'd be a waste to just throw such an expensive doll away, so I carried it with me as a talisman.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: But I lost it a few years back when they evacuated the mine in a hurry.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: How did you manage to find it?

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: *sigh* I'd planned to work a few more years in the mine while my health allowed, but The Chasm is far more dangerous than I thought.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: I don't think I'll ever go down into the mine again.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: By the way, please tell Muning that I shan't dare go down into the mine anymore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No problem. Just remember to take Qi Nan with you when you go home.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Qi Nan? She lives in Liyue Harbor and is very busy with work at the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Why would she be here?

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: But you are right. She has grown up and I've grown old. I should spend more time with her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not what we mean. Paimon means the little girl over there...

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: The little girl?

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Is there anyone there? Ah, come on, don't you go scaring me. This isn't funny.

response.speaker: Qi Ding
response.text: Alright, you know what? I'll go home right away. Please remember to tell Muning that I'm not going down into the mine anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: #Oh? If it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... What's with him? He smells of gunpowder!

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: Huh? Do I really smell that much? Oh well, guess I'll have to take a bath when I return home. My daughter will give me an earful if I don't...

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: *sigh* The Chasm is a strange place. By no means will I come here again.

dialogues.speaker: Qi Ding
dialogues.text: *sob* My poor daughter, how could I have lost your doll...
